findings.title: LimitRange's default limit is below the container's request
findings.cause: Deployment kd-limitrange-default-below-request/web cannot create pods: container web requests 256Mi of memory and sets no memory limit, so the namespace's LimitRange gave it its default limit, 128Mi, and a request above the limit makes the pod invalid

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Error creating: Pod "web-6c8ddf67c6-hnl8s" is invalid: spec.containers[0].resources.requests: Invalid value: "256Mi": must be less than or equal to memory limit of 128Mi

evidence.what: the pod template's requests and limits
evidence.command: kubectl get deployment web -n kd-limitrange-default-below-request -o jsonpath='{range .spec.template.spec.containers[*]}{.name}{" "}{.resources}{"\n"}{end}'

evidence.what: the namespace's LimitRanges and their defaults

findings.fix: Set the memory limit of container web in the pod template, at or above its request of 256Mi, so that the LimitRange's default is not used; or lower the request to 128Mi or less; or raise the default in the LimitRange.
